summary: 30-foot pole tower with an L-4 cab in the Flathead National Forest, built 1931 and abandoned in 1965. No source describes the site today.

facts.design: 30-foot pole tower with an L-4 cab
facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1965. No source describes what remains on the site.

events.note: firelookout.com lists a 30-foot pole L-4 tower, one mile ESE of the prominent summit

evidence.quote: 1931: 30' pole L-4 tower 1 mile ESE of prominent summit. Abandoned 1965.

evidence.supports: L-4 cab on the ground or atop pole or timber towers up to 100 feet
evidence.quote: either sitting on the ground or atop pole or timber towers up to 100 feet high

notes_for_editor: Thin evidence: one history page (firelookout.com) gives the 1931 build and 1965 abandonment; the FFLA list gives the gone status. The 30-foot figure is a pole height; the page does not say whether it runs to the cab floor, so height_m is not written. Record elevation_m is null; 6,180 ft is about 1,884 m by conversion, not added to the record. No access, staffing, fire or current-site source found. Record status and kind agree with the sources; no corrections proposed.
